## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Lè yīngluò zhuāngyán fāngbiàn pǐn jīng* (T566) is a one-fascicle alternate translation of the *Strīvivartavyākaraṇa-sūtra* (cf. [KR6i0197](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0197)). The translator, Tánmóyéshè 曇摩耶舍 ([曇摩耶舍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E6%91%A9%E8%80%B6%E8%88%8D); Dharmayaśas), was active under the Yáo Qín alongside Kumārajīva.

**Abstract**

A short Mahāyāna text on a woman's *vyākaraṇa* through skillful means. Tánmóyéshè was a Kashmiri monk who arrived at Cháng'ān around 405 CE; his translation activity is dated 405–413 CE, contemporaneous with Kumārajīva.
